## Passing parameters

Some parameters aren't read when passed as command line arguments namely
- idx of the dataset
- overwrite argument

Ideally, pass all parameters in the config.yaml file (which is the centralized config file for your experiment)

Things I have managed to change through CL:
- model


## MongoDB connection

A mongoDB database is necessary to keep track of experiments run from multiple nodes and multiple setups. In a .env file you will need to export the variables necessary to this connections
WARNING: these are secrets, do not publish them

'''bash
# Generated by MongoDB Atlas onboarding.
# This file contains sensitive credentials.
# DO NOT commit this file to version control.
# Store it securely (e.g. use a password manager or secrets vault).

MONGODB_USERNAME=<username>
MONGODB_PASSWORD=<password>
MONGODB_URI=<server_uri>
MONGODB_DB=<name>
~
